Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style less Super Saiyan Sam Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of Sam, since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including beach portraits.


Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. 
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

There are 3 versions. One is the Content Patcher version, Drag into Stardew Valley\Mods to install.

The other version (in the optional file) is replacement files for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod. To install find where you installed your DCBurger's Portrait mod (somewhere in Stardew Valley\Mods folder). Drag the "assets" folder from my zip into the Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] DCBurger's High Res Portraits to overwrite the folder in it to install.
The replacement version prevents assets from getting loaded two times, choose whichever version you prefer/which Ever version that works for you.

Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.


The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
